what: Camden Property Trust owns about 58,000 apartments, concentrated in Texas, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina and Arizona, and rents them on one-year leases.
customers: Renters in Houston, Dallas, Austin, Atlanta, Orlando, Tampa, Charlotte and Phoenix.
money: newly built communities and fee income
moat: Ownership concentrated in the metros where Americans are moving, with enough scale in each to price and operate efficiently.
risks: Heavy new apartment supply in its Sun Belt markets has stalled rent growth
Free cash flow is negative because development spending exceeds operating cash
opportunities: 9 times earnings with a 24.4% net margin
Apartment construction starts have collapsed, so the supply wave should clear by 2027
Analysts see about 14% upside, with 22 covering the stock
watch: New supply deliveries in Austin and Nashville, and same-store revenue growth.
